description: One streamed OpenAI chat answer with usage, traced by OpenLLMetry.
notes: TRACELOOP_TRACE_CONTENT is true, which is also the default, so message content is recorded on the span as gen_ai.input.messages and gen_ai.output.messages. TRACELOOP_METRICS_ENABLED is false. These provider packages have no TRACELOOP_TELEMETRY switch and no vendor export URL; spans go through the harness tracer provider. gen_ai.prompt.N is not written. The client sets stream_options.include_usage. The mock waits 120 ms before the first chunk and splits the answer into 4 chunks. The span also has seven gen_ai.content.completion.chunk events with no attributes. Prompt 20 and completion 8 are copied, and cache_read.input_tokens is 0. Time to first token is a metric, and metrics are disabled, so the span has no timing attribute.
